answer: Prism Challenge Attribution: each identity must, on demand, sign a challenge derived from a random beacon plus its own history depth. A clone sharing history reproduces the parent's signature exactly, so collision exposes the fork. A sparrow agent relaying for a clone triggers a trace to its origin registration. The attacker pays one fresh registration and a full synthetic history replay per identity, driving marginal cost near its nadir for cheap clones but linear in genuinely independent histories.
